title: Toronto man, woman charged with murder in Etobicoke shooting
article: A man and woman have been charged with first degree murder in connection to the shooting death of Deandre Campbell-Kelly, Toronto police say.
On Friday, Feb. 7 around 11 p.m., police responded to a call for a shooting in front of 546 The West Mall, near Rathburn Road and Renforth Drive, in Etobicoke .
Officers found a man lying in the snow with gunshot wounds. He was taken to hospital where he died.
The victim was later identified as Campbell-Kelly . He was 29, and is the city's 10th homicide victim of 2020.
An initial report said two people were "seen running away" from the scene, but did not include descriptions of suspects.
On Tuesday, Feb. 11, police announced arrests in the case.

Alyshia Smith, 19, and Anthony Johnson, 23, both of Toronto, were arrested Monday and jointly charged with first degree murder. Police did not release their photographs. They were scheduled to appear in court Tuesday.
Anyone with information on the case is asked to contact the homicide squad at 416-808-7400 , or Crime Stoppers anonymously at 416-222-8477 or online at 222tips.com .
